nodes.title: Decode
widgets_values:
## Decode

Make sure to adjust the number of tiles and overlap to fit your hardware.
(fewer tiles will result in faster execution, but will require more memory).

### Recommended settings

| node settings (pixels)                     | resolved latent geometry        |
| ------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------- |
| `512 / 64 / 128 / 32`                      | 16x16, ov 2 - 16f ov 4 |
| `768 / 192 / 128 / 32`                     | 24x24, ov 6 - 16f ov 4 |
| `1024 / 256 / 128 / 48`                    | 32x32, ov 8 - 16f, ov 6         |
| `1536 / 384 / 192 / 48`                    | 48x48, ov 12 - 24f, ov 6        |
| `768 / 192 / spatial-only`                 | 24x24, ov 6 - no temporal split |

nodes.title: Inputs
widgets_values:
## Inputs

Load a video on the left. Size combos (`tile_size`, `initial_canvas_size`, `output_size`) are widgets on **Preprocess**.

### Stage 1 prompt

Describe the **change** you want to apply to the input video.

The negative prompt is used as written and is never enhanced. Enable **Enhance positive prompt** on Input Parameters to rewrite the positive locally, or paste an **LTX API key** to encode through the API.

See the [prompting guide](https://docs.ltx.io/open-source-model/usage-guides/prompting-guide).

### Stage 2 prompt

This pass will use spatial tiling (read more in **Preprocess**. Describe **look and style** only: lighting, palette, film stock, sharpness, grade. Do **not** name specific objects, people, or props ("a red car", "the woman in a hat") — anything you name can stamp into every spatial tile after upscale.

nodes.title: Model Links
widgets_values:
## Model Links

**LTX-2.5 Model Weights**

Make sure to click the "Agree and Access" button the first time you download.

- [ Distilled model - ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-bf16.safetensors ](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/diffusion_models/ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-bf16.safetensors)

- [ Audio VAE - ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors ](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/vae/ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors)

- Video VAE - one of these:
  - [ Diffusion decoder ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16.safetensors ](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/vae/ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16.safetensors) - Best quality
  - [ Convolutional decoder - ltx-2.5-video-vae-conv-bf16.safetensors ](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/vae/ltx-2.5-video-vae-conv-bf16.safetensors) - Lower memory & faster


**Text Encoder - finetuned for LTX-2.5**
- [gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/text_encoders/gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-bf16.safetensors)

**Text Enhancer**
- [Google Gemma 4 E2B IT](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/gemma-4/blob/main/text_encoders/gemma4_e2b_it_bf16.safetensors)

**IC-LoRA**
- [Refine Details - ltx-2.5-22b-ic-lora-refine-details-1.0.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5-22b-IC-LoRA-Refine-Details/blob/main/ltx-2.5-22b-ic-lora-refine-details-1.0.safetensors) 
- [Day To Night - ltx-2.5-22b-ic-lora-day-to-night-0.9.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5-22b-IC-LoRA-Day-To-Night/blob/main/ltx-2.5-22b-ic-lora-day-to-night-0.9.safetensors)

Stage 1 defaults to the Day-To-Night IC-LoRA. Stage 2 uses `MODEL_stage2` (both use the 2.5 distilled model + an IC-LoRA — default is the detail refiner).
Swap either LoRA on **Load Models**.

**Model Storage Location**

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   │      ├── gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-bf16.safetensors
│   │      └── gemma4_e2b_it_bf16.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │      └── ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-bf16.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │      └── ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors
│   │      └── ltx-2.5-video-vae-conv-bf16.safetensors / ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16.safetensors
│   └── 📂 loras/
│          └── ltx-2.5-22b-ic-lora-refine-details-1.0.safetensors
│          └── ltx-2.5-22b-ic-lora-day-to-night-0.9.safetensors

```

## Report Issues
To report any issues when running this workflow, [go to GitHub](https://github.com/Lightricks/ComfyUI-LTXVideo/issues)

widgets_values:
## Generate — stage 1

**Tiled Fusion Sampler**, 8 distilled steps. Tile equals the FullHD canvas (no spatial tiling). `SAMPLER` is euler. Sigmas must end at 0.

nodes.title: Preprocess
widgets_values:
## Preprocess

This flow resizes the input video to `initial_canvas_size` (qHD/HD/FullHD) for the 1st stage generation, that way the model can see the entire canvas in every step to have the full context.

In the 2nd stage, it upscales the output of the 1st stage to `output_size` (FullHD/4K/8K) and uses the initial input video as a guide for the fine details. It uses a tiled sampler in that stage, you can set the `tile_size` (qHD/HD/fullHD) in this combo or to any custom resolution inside the subgraph. Think of a tile like a stencil on the large output canvas, that the model focuses in every step of the generation. The size you choose should fit the ic-lora you picked and your VRAM size.

widgets_values:
## Preprocess — stage 2

Latent ×2 (×4 when `output_size` is 8K). Fresh encode of the stage-2 prompt, then IC-LoRA guide at output resolution. `use_streaming` is on; `use_tiled_encode` stays **false**.

Frames, size, and frame count go into **Preprocess**, where Get Tiling Sizes picks a model-legal canvas (multiple of 32, `tile_frames` = 8n+1) and resizes the guide to it.
